<thought>Using the isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) suggests ~8 carbons. Subtracting the monoisotopic mass of 8 C (96 Da) from the neutral mass (~126.10 Da) leaves ~30.10 Da, which matches one O (15.99 Da) plus ~14 H (14.11 Da). The formula C₈H₁₄O fits the observed mass and isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
